title: diosma rotundifolia
intro: Diosma rotundifolia, commonly known as round-leaved diosma, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing swelling and preventing the growth of bacteria. The therapeutic actions of diosma rotundifolia include its ability to reduce fever, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
